signals.text: Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 2% vs revenue at 1%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin expanded 68 bps in 3 years (18.2% → 18.8%).
Working-capital days shortened by 16 days in 3 years (54 → 38).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 109% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.

guidance.statement: Management targets maintaining PBDIT margins within the 18% to 20% band.
guidance.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

guidance.statement: Management expects full year FY27 volume growth to stay in the 8% to 10% range.
guidance.quote: overall, we have given our direction that we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%.

delivered.statement: Overall volume growth for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately 9%.
Decorative value grew at 16.6% in Q1 FY27.
Standalone top line grew by about 17% in Q1 FY27.
Standalone PBDIT margin for the quarter was strong at 22%.
Consolidated top line growth reached approximately 18% in Q1 FY27.
Consolidated PBDIT margins stood at 20.6%, up about 240 bps YoY.

calls.tone: Confident on demand recovery and premiumization, but cautious regarding raw material volatility and intense competition.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned if 9% volume growth was satisfactory given a soft base and price hikes.
Analysts probed when margins in industrial segments would normalize after a ~120 bps drop.
Analysts sought quantification of the low-cost inventory benefit on gross margins this quarter.
Analysts questioned whether gross margins face compression given 25% inflation versus ~9-10% price hikes.

business.summary: Asian Paints beautifies, transforms, and preserves spaces and objects, manufacturing and selling paints, coatings, home decor, and industrial products globally with a strong emphasis on innovation, premiumization, and services.

segments.name: Decorative and Home Decor
segments.note: Core business including paints, kitchen, bath, and lighting.

segments.name: Industrial Business
segments.note: Includes PPGAP (Automotive OE) and General Industrial.

guidance.statement: We are looking at commissioning the first phase of the VAM, VAE project in the next quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at commissioning the first phase of this project in the next quarter.

delivered.statement: Consolidated Net Sales stood at ₹35,516 crores, representing growth of 5.1%.
Consolidated Operating Margins measured by PBDIT increased to 18.9% from 17.8% in the previous year.
Net Profit after minority interest grew by 17.9% to ₹4,325 crores.
New products contributed approximately 16% of overall revenues during the year.
Expanded distribution network by adding nearly 6,000 new retail touchpoints.

calls.tone: confident on long-term opportunities, cautious on near-term crude volatility, competition, and demand headwinds

pushback.gist: Analysts and shareholders raised concerns regarding intense competition from new entrants like Birla Opus and price/discount pressures.
Questions were raised regarding the sharp increase in the Managing Director and CEO's remuneration.
A shareholder questioned the rationale and necessity behind the increase in promoter share pledging in March 2026.
Shareholders repeatedly requested a bonus issue and highlighted lack of stock price appreciation over the past three years.

guidance.statement: We are still looking at least a high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8-10%.
guidance.quote: We are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

guidance.statement: We will try to maintain our margin guidance of 18-20% going forward.

guidance.statement: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative due to government spending and infrastructure investments.
guidance.quote: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative, given the investment happening in the infrastructure and Government spending that is happening in this area.

guidance.statement: International business is expected to continue to grow and strongly contribute to growth in Q1.
guidance.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow and therefore, both industrial and international will strongly contribute to our growth going forward, as far as Q1 is concerned.

delivered.statement: Decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth and 10.2% value growth in Q4.
Full coatings volume growth reached 12.7% and value growth reached 11% in Q4.
Standalone PBDIT margin for Q4 expanded by 260 bps year-on-year to 21.2%.
Standalone net sales grew by 10.3% year-on-year for the quarter.
Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6% in Q4 supported by 1.4% deflation.

calls.tone: confident on demand recovery and margin resilience, cautious on geopolitical volatility and high inflation

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether discounting levels remain high despite price hikes, which management confirmed.
Scepticism on maintaining 18-20% margin guidance given crude/inflation pressures resembling the FY22 downturn.
Concerns over how double-digit cumulative price hikes will impact consumer demand elasticity.
Questions on whether a low volume-value gap of 2.2% to 3-4% was driven by pre-buying/upstocking ahead of price hikes.

delivered.statement: Delivered high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% for decorative business in Q3.
Decorative value growth was 2.8% in Q3, resulting in a volume-value gap of approximately 5%.
Standalone gross margin reached 44.9%, higher by 200 bps year-on-year in Q3.
Standalone PBDIT margin stood strong at 21.4%, up 100 bps year-on-year in Q3.
PPGAP industrial joint venture delivered stellar performance growing by 17% in Q3.
New products contributed approximately 16% to overall revenues in Q3.

calls.tone: Confident on demand recovery and strong market share gains, cautious on competitive intensity and consumption shifts.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why paint industry growth remains muted despite lower interest rates and new market entrants.
Analysts pressed on whether the 3-5% gap between volume and value growth will persist permanently.
Questioned how Asian Paints maintains high margins and steady pricing despite aggressive moves and price hikes by new players.

credibility.line: Management delivers reliably on volume growth and operating margins, though auxiliary commitments like skilling are quietly dropped without accountability.
